description: Puts the date and time above every message in a thread, yours and the agent's. Labels read "Today, 2:34 PM", "Yesterday, 22:10" or "Oct 3, 9:15 AM", and older messages add the year. Choose English or Russian and a 12- or 24-hour clock, or let the plugin follow your computer's settings. A BB update can hide the labels until the plugin catches up; the chat keeps working.
